questions.prompt: You hold 9c 9d on 9h Ks 4c. That is…

choices.text: A set, among the strongest made hands.

questions.explanation: Three nines. You are ahead of top pair and most two pair.

questions.prompt: You hold Jc Td on Qh 9c 2d. That is…

choices.text: An open-ended straight draw, 8 outs. King or eight completes it.

questions.explanation: Queen, jack, ten, and nine are consecutive. Either end completes the straight. There is no flush draw on this rainbow board.

questions.prompt: You hold 7c 6c on Ks 8d 2h. That is…

choices.text: Air. No pair, no straight draw, no flush draw.

questions.explanation: Do not invent equity. This hand needs help that the flop did not offer.

choices.text: A flush draw plus an open-ender is about 15 outs, not a made hand and not 9 outs only.
They are always the nuts already
They should be folded on every flop

questions.explanation: Count overlapping outs once. Fifteen outs is a strong draw, still not a guaranteed win.
